description: Returns one stage reference document of a playbook (e.g. the FNMA playbook's DISCOVERY, RECONCILE, SYNTHESIS, PP-UPDATE, CHANGELOG or UPDATING stage). Inputs: `id`, `name` (one of the playbook's `references`). Playbook tools accept only ids and reference names, no document text; the user's P&Ps and loan files stay in their own chat.

id.description: Playbook id: one of fnma-ai-lender-letter, fha-underwriting-qc, va-loan-qc, usda-loan-qc.

name.description: Reference name, one of the playbook's `references`.

name: get_playbook_reference

error.description: Present only on an error or refusal: not_found, ambiguous, unparsed, empty_terms, unknown_playbook, unknown_reference, offset_out_of_range, daily_capacity_reached.

fallback.description: On daily_capacity_reached: where the full corpus can be downloaded.

guidance.description: On a refusal or empty search: the server's explanation.

hint.description: On an error: the server's explanation.

notice.description: Terms notice: research use only, not legal advice.

resets.description: On daily_capacity_reached: when capacity resets (00:00 UTC).

title: Get playbook reference
